info.title: Voice surface
info.description: The surface Voice over HTTP (spec/api.md § Outcomes): POST /call/<member> for a row that declares no route, the declared METHOD /path (http::Rest) for one that does, the body by the JSON codec. requires is checked against this exposure's role source at the serve site, before a request is queued: a boundary check, never a proof over the program's internal call paths; a request accepted runs to completion: a timeout or a lost connection does not mean it did not run, and ending the wait never rolls it back.

delete.description: Requires admin under the exposure's role source; the server still authorizes every request.

404.description: no route serves the path (refusal: not_found); or handler error: CtlError (NotFound, @not_found)

405.description: the path takes other methods, named in Allow (refusal: method_not_allowed)

409.description: refusal: digest_mismatch; or handler error: CtlError (Conflict, @conflict)

503.description: refusal: shutting_down, unavailable; or handler error: CtlError (Unavailable, NotReady, @unavailable)
